text:
[Council File 26-0906-S16]
Motion (Jurado – McOsker) relative to the City’s process for overseeing and approving the installation of a solar energy system on large commercial or industrial buildings, and related matters.
(This item was referred to Energy and Environment Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council directed the city to establish a process for overseeing and approving installation of solar energy systems on large commercial or industrial buildings.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee approved item(s) (Oct 1, 2026)
